---
name: ble-session-appliance
description: Control BLE Session Appliance through the generated BLE device CLI.
---

Use `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli status --json` to inspect replay-backed status output. Use `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli session status --json` to inspect the generated session requirements before building live BLE IPC. Use `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli telemetry capture --json` and `ble-session-appliance-pp-cli telemetry latest --json` for the local telemetry store scaffold.
